question: A composite wall consists of a rectangle 12 m by 9 m with a triangular window of base 4 m and height 3 m cut out. If the wall needs to be painted at ₹120 per m², find the painting cost after deducting the window area.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Area = Area of Rectangle − Area of Triangle

⇒ Net Area = (12 × 9) − (1/2 × 4 × 3) = 108 − 6 = 102 m²

⇒ Total Cost = 102 × 120 = ₹12,240

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the wall = 12 m

Breadth of the wall = 9 m

Base of the window = 4 m

Height of the window = 3 m

Painting rate = ₹120 per m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of Rectangle = length × breadth

Area of Triangle = 1/2 × base × height

 
 
 
 

 
 
• 
 
 12 m
 9 m
 4 m
 3 m

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the rectangular wall = 12 × 9 = 108 m²

⇒ Area of the triangular window = 1/2 × 4 × 3 = 6 m²

⇒ Area to be painted = 108 − 6 = 102 m²

⇒ Total cost of painting = 102 × 120 = ₹12,240

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Composite Shapes

The total area of a composite figure is calculated by adding or subtracting the areas of the basic geometric shapes that constitute it.

Area of a Triangle

The area is given by the formula: Area = 1/2 × base × height, where the height is the perpendicular distance from the base to the opposite vertex.

Cost Calculation

Total Cost = Total Area × Rate per unit square. Both the area and the rate must have matching unit dimensions before multiplication.
